name: Croaky's Head
objectiveText: Deliver Croaky's Head to Merell Ross at Ridgepoint Tower. Croaky's Head (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body: This quest is started from the drop "Croaky's Head" from Croaky. He is a gold plate elite murloc at The Darkened Bank, you may encounter him at the southern most edge by the river while doing the quest called Downstream.
I dont think this quest exists in the beta. I found Merell Ross and she doesn't have a quest available.
